PHYSICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mechanical Properties of Materials? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mechanical Properties of Materials.

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

4. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Physics? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Physics.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Physics.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Physics.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Physics.

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of Waves? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of Waves.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of Waves.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of Waves.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of Waves.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Moments and equilibrium? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Moments and equilibrium.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Moments and equilibrium.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Moments and equilibrium.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Moments and equilibrium.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy, Work, Power and Machines? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy, Work, Power and Machines.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy, Work, Power and Machines.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy, Work, Power and Machines.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy, Work, Power and Machines.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Electronics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

4. B — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
